name: Cinematheque
description: Cinematheque adds a tab to the Jellyfin web client for film lovers: directors and actors with their filmography in your library, national cinemas (Hong Kong, Japan, Italy...) with a decade breakdown, and curated film movements such as the French New Wave or Italian Neorealism. Requires the File Transformation plugin for the tab.
overview: Browse your films by director, actor, country and film movement

versions.changelog: Fixes a web cache that showed one user's lists to the next on a shared browser, lists that stopped at 480 items, collections left out of sync, and a configuration page that could erase movements. The library is read once for every user, and the tab sits in Jellyfin's header. Removes the 0.1 Directors and Actors endpoints. See CHANGELOG.md.

People identified by TMDB id, screenwriters, watch progress, "pick a film for me", primary-country view, translated movements edited in a form, optional movement collections with posters, and a tile in My Media. See CHANGELOG.md.
First release: directors, actors, countries and movements.
